waste_details.reason_for_no_provision: This is not relevant for the application. This is a cladding replacement application.

description:
PROPOSAL IS TO UNDERTAKE REMEDIAL WORK TO PARTIALLY REPLACE
EXISTING EXTERNAL ELEMENTS WITH A SUITABLE NON-COMBUSTIBLE ALTERNATIVE THAT IS
SUITABLE FOR RELEVANT UP-TO-DATE REGULATIONS- WORKS ARE TO BE IN ACCORDANCE
WITH THE RECOMMENDATIONS MADE IN THE FIRE RISK APPRAISAL OF EXTERNAL WALL
REPORT. (FRAEW). THE REPLACED ELEMENTS WILL MATCH THE EXISTING ONES EXCEPT FOR
THE GLASS PANELS, WHICH WILL BE REPLACED WITH METAL PANELS - THOUGH MAINTAINING
A SIMILAR GENERAL APPEARANCE.
